payload.title: Grant Babulus access to accounts and list it in Anthus One
payload.description: Depends on Prospectus work: the operator entitlement route is merged but unreachable and no operator holds the grant (Prospectus kanbus-592fbb activation), the product registry with launch links (kanbus-bf45cb), and the Anthus One portal at one.anth.us (Prospectus PR 56, not yet hosted). Babulus side: check the `babulus` entitlement on sign-in and show a clear no-access state. Invitations, access requests and billing follow later in Prospectus.
